title: Interval Coloring
statementMd:
Aryo has got a lot of intervals for his $2418$th birthday. He is really excited and decided to color all these intervals with some colors. He has a simple rule for himself. He calls a coloring nice if there exists no three intervals $*a*, *b*$ and $*c*$ such that the following conditions are satisfied simultaneously:

- $*a*, *b*$ and $*c*$ are colored with the same color,
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13e114f3011cd36a2ec6f67d1d430ed7b4aa929a.png),
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/757f4f5722c49c0fded2196ac865656d84d5c9b8.png),
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b624870e858f2cc10ec24ad57cc974e5489421b.png).

Moreover he found out that for every intervals $*i*$ and $*j*$, there is at least one point in $*i*$ which isn't in $*j*$.

Given some set of intervals. You have to find the minimum number $*k*$, such that Aryo can find a nice coloring with $*k*$ colors.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$), number of intervals.

The following $*n*$ lines contain a interval description each. Each interval is described by two numbers $*s*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*}$ which are the start and end points of it ($- 10^{5} < *s*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*} < 10^{5}$, $*s*_{*i*} ≤ *e*_{*i*}$). See samples for clarity. A square bracket stands for including of the corresponding endpoint, while a round bracket stands for excluding.

## Output

Write a single integer $*k*$ — the minimum number of colors needed for a nice coloring.
statementZhMd:
Aryo 在他 $2418$ 岁生日时收到了许多区间。他非常兴奋，决定用一些颜色给所有这些区间染色。他为自己制定了一个简单的规则：如果不存在三个区间 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$，使得以下条件同时满足，则称这种染色是美好的：

- $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$ 被染成相同的颜色；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13e114f3011cd36a2ec6f67d1d430ed7b4aa929a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/757f4f5722c49c0fded2196ac865656d84d5c9b8.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b624870e858f2cc10ec24ad57cc974e5489421b.png)。

此外，他发现对于任意区间 $*i*$ 和 $*j*$，在 $*i*$ 中至少存在一个点不属于 $*j*$。

给定一些区间，请求出最小的 $*k*$，使得 Aryo 可以使用 $*k*$ 种颜色进行美好的染色。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$），表示区间的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一个区间的描述。每个区间由两个数 $*s*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*}$ 表示其起点和终点（$- 10^{5} < *s*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*} < 10^{5}$，$*s*_{*i*} ≤ *e*_{*i*}$）。具体含义请参见样例。方括号表示包含对应的端点，圆括号表示不包含对应的端点。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 $*k*$，表示进行美好染色所需的最少颜色数。
